actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent biological identity supported by a strong, FDR-significant WXS BAP1 enrichment (OR=20.55, q=0.00031) together with a coherent RNA immune/inflammatory program (allograft rejection, interferon alpha response; SMDs ~0.9-1.05, q<0.003). CNV is null, but absence of CNV support does not contradict the identity. Confounder testing shows no significant technical or tissue-source-site association, so measured technical factors do not provide a dominant alternative explanation. Structural metrics are weak (near-zero silhouettes) but do not positively support a Split or Merge, and no pairwise boundary evidence indicates C0001 is insufficiently distinct from another set. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is therefore better supported than Drop.

C0002 shows convergent molecular signals: FDR-significant WXS PBRM1 enrichment (OR=6.65, q=0.00308) with DST/PIK3CA enrichments, a coherent CNV 9p/CDKN2A/JAK2 loss pattern (q=0.0398), and RNA MYC-targets up-regulation (SMD=0.808, q=0.01015). This is a coherent, biologically interpretable identity rather than an isolated favorable observation. Confounder testing shows no significant technical association, and the internal fused probe shows the strongest resampling stability among sets (ARI 0.809, PAC 0.370). No positive structural evidence supports Split or Merge. Retaining C0002 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0003 has a coherent identity defined by a broad, FDR-significant RNA program (23 pathways; allograft rejection down, pancreas beta cells/heme metabolism/TGF-beta up; SMDs ~0.78-0.94) and a strong, coherent CNV pattern (18 significant features; lower chr16p/chr12p/chr16q/chr12q and lower FGA, absence of CDKN2A loss; q down to 0.00156). WXS is null, which does not contradict the identity. Confounder testing shows no significant technical association. Structural cohesion is modest but positive in WSI/RNA/CNV, and no pairwise boundary evidence positively supports merging C0003 with any other set. Retaining C0003 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0004 is defined by a strong, FDR-significant depletion of canonical ccRCC drivers PBRM1 (OR=0.047, q=0.00138) and VHL (OR=0.193, q=0.0212), with a nominal TP53 enrichment. Although the defining feature is absence of mutations, this is a coherent and interpretable molecular identity (a driver-mutation-depleted subset) rather than an isolated observation, and it is the strongest modality-level signal for this set (WXS probe silhouette 0.120). RNA and CNV are null but do not actively contradict the identity, and confounder testing shows no significant technical association. Structural metrics are weak and resampling stability is the lowest among sets, but this does not constitute positive evidence for Split or Merge, and no pairwise boundary evidence supports merging C0004 with another set. Retaining C0004 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.
